alternative_rejected.option: LLM-generated prose for repository context assessment
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Violates structural-facts-from-parsers rule in AGENTS.md. Tree-sitter indexer produces deterministic, repeatable structural facts. LLM-generated prose is non-deterministic, unverifiable, and cannot produce reproducible digests.

alternative_rejected.option: Build from scratch ignoring existing digestion/intake infrastructure
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Existing digestion/intake modules (open_local_repository, ecosystem detection, topology mapping) provide mature foundation. Reusing them avoids duplicated authentication, git operations, and filesystem safety guards. The context release model composes over intake output rather than replacing it.

alternative_rejected.option: Add all tree-sitter grammars upfront (TypeScript, Rust, and more)
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Python-only indexer proves the structural indexing pattern and digest pipeline end-to-end. TypeScript and Rust grammars are deferred: the multi-ecosystem dependency classifier already handles TypeScript and Rust manifests through static analysis (package.json, Cargo.toml), and the indexer's modular parser architecture accommodates new grammars without schema changes.

strongest_suspected_weakness: Quarantine isolation is best-effort chmod (is_read_only_intended) rather than a hard security boundary — .git directory content remains writable; symlink traversal protection relies on follow_symlinks=False which is best-effort at POSIX level. Execution risk assessor does static pattern matching on instruction text and cannot detect transitively invoked scripts whose wrapper commands appear safe at the surface level.
proposed_reviewer_attack_surface: Quarantine path traversal via '/..' or '../..' in remote repository URLs
Safe validation probe executing wrapper commands whose transitively invoked scripts carry risk not detected by surface-level pattern matching
Dependency classifier skipping large lockfiles or malformed TOML silently
Structural indexer OOM on very large repositories (no file count limit enforced)
Content-light guarantee depends on model design, not runtime enforcement — projection builders could leak raw paths or symbol names without detection if contracts are violated in future edits
Instruction scanner scope deduplication correctness under conflicting nested instructions
Incremental compiler observing changes to deleted files (negative diffs)
Deterministic digest computation producing different results with different JSON serializer implementations
